goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.first-layer: Solve yellow corners. Choose when cross=true and firstLayer=false.
criteria.middle-layer: Solve middle edges. Choose when firstLayer=true and middle=false.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.

frame.note: Fixed frame: yellow D, white U. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face. Camera has no effect.

edges: Edge DF is at BL. yellow faces B; green faces L.
Edge DR is at DB. yellow faces B; red faces D.
Edge DB is at DR. yellow faces D; blue faces R.
Edge DL is at FL. yellow faces F; orange faces L.

gatherTarget.instructions: Assume the goal is gathering missing petals, regardless of the goal answer in this request. Choose an edge with petal=no AND bottom=no. Preserve both existing petals and solved bottom edges. Prefer an accessible edge; any eligible edge is allowed. If none is eligible, choose none.

criteria.none: No eligible edge for this hypothetical goal

transferTarget.instructions: Assume the goal is transferring petals, regardless of the goal answer in this request. Choose an edge with petal=yes AND bottom=no. Any eligible petal is allowed. If none is eligible, choose none.

criteria.none: No eligible edge for this hypothetical goal

situation.instructions: Classify this selected edge using ONLY currentPosition and yellowDirection. First check yellowDirection=U (petal). Otherwise currentPosition starting D is bottom; starting U is top; all other edge positions are middle. The piece identity is deliberately omitted.

criteria.bottomDown: Edge is on D and yellow faces D
criteria.bottomSide: Edge is on D and yellow faces a side
criteria.middle: Edge is between side faces, not on U or D
criteria.topSide: Edge is on U and yellow faces a side

reference.instructions: Choose the reference front. If yellowDirection is F/R/B/L, choose that face. If yellowDirection is U or D, choose the other letter of currentPosition. Use current position only.

routine.instructions: Choose a routine whose position AND yellow direction match the current target, with no affectedBottomSlot in protectedBottomSlots. Ignore landing occupancy for now. Prefer a lift over staging initially. If a previous routine was rejected by the model, choose a different matching routine, including a staging routine. Do not repeat a rejected routine.

setup.instructions: Choose a U rotation that moves the current freeSlots onto ALL requiredFreeSlots. Track empty spaces, not occupied petals. Rotating preserves the shape of the empty pattern: opposite empties cannot become adjacent empties. Choose reconsider if no rotation works.

target.instructions: Choose one unfinished piece for the current goal. Keep working on previousTarget while its stage goal is incomplete, so setup/staging is followed by insertion/lifting. intent_DRF.instructions: Choose the immediate intention for the exact record at `stagePieces[0]`. Read its position and stickers, not the position suggested by its permanent piece identifier. Insertion staging positions: DRF→UFR, DFL→ULF, DLB→UBL, DBR→URB. ALIGN means only rotate U to place target directly above its destination. INSERT means use the short skill matching yellow sticker direction. EXTRACT means lift the misplaced bottom corner. REORIENT means use yellow-up insertion or a trigger. Preservation is required after a complete skill, not every internal turn.

criteria.reorient: Target is above its home with yellow pointing U.
criteria.extract: Target is in bottom but misplaced or twisted.

frame.note: All positions, sticker directions, and algorithm notation in this question use a reference with original F as F. U and D are unchanged. Piece IDs remain permanent identities.

state.goal: Solve yellow corners on D while preserving the yellow cross.

operation.instructions: Execute the chosenIntention, selecting just ONE next setup turn or complete skill. The target corner must move from target.position to the top slot directly above target.destination. DRF requires UFR; DFL requires ULF; DLB requires UBL; DBR requires URB. Use ONLY local destination, never original piece identity. Read U position cycles in the options. Avoid repeating an action from this exact state that already failed. A setup need not solve the piece; insertion comes later.

criteria.U: Turn U clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→L, L→B, B→R, R→F; the U sticker direction stays fixed. Corner positions: UFR→ULF, ULF→UBL, UBL→URB, URB→UFR. Edge positions: UF→UL, UL→UB, UB→UR, UR→UF.
criteria.U': Turn U counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→R, L→F, B→L, R→B; the U sticker direction stays fixed. Corner positions: UFR→URB, ULF→UFR, UBL→ULF, URB→UBL. Edge positions: UF→UR, UL→UF, UB→UL, UR→UB.
criteria.U2: Turn U 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→B, L→R, B→F, R→L; the U sticker direction stays fixed. Corner positions: UFR→UBL, ULF→URB, UBL→UFR, URB→ULF. Edge positions: UF→UB, UL→UR, UB→UF, UR→UL.
criteria.reconsider: No suitable action: stop for inspection rather than move arbitrarily.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.first-layer: Solve yellow corners. Choose when cross=true and firstLayer=false.
criteria.middle-layer: Solve middle edges. Choose when firstLayer=true and middle=false.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.

frame.note: Fixed frame. Yellow D first; white U last. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face.

state.goal: Solve yellow corners on D while preserving the yellow cross.

target.instructions: Choose one unfinished piece for the current goal. Keep working on previousTarget while its stage goal is incomplete, so setup/staging is followed by insertion/lifting. Change target when the previous one is complete, absent from this stage, or excluded by recovery. When choosing a new target, prefer an accessible piece. Do not choose pieces marked stage goal complete. A solved bottom edge is NOT a complete daisy petal. For top-layer stages select whole.

criteria.DRF: DRF at UBL; destination DRF; stage goal incomplete.
criteria.DBR: DBR at ULF; destination DBR; stage goal incomplete.
criteria.DLB: DLB at DRF; destination DLB; stage goal incomplete.
criteria.DFL: DFL at DBR; destination DFL; stage goal incomplete.

intent_DRF.instructions: Choose the immediate intention for the exact record at `stagePieces[0]`. Read its position and stickers, not the position suggested by its permanent piece identifier. Insertion staging positions: DRF→UFR, DFL→ULF, DLB→UBL, DBR→URB. ALIGN means only rotate U to place target directly above its destination. INSERT means use the short skill matching yellow sticker direction. EXTRACT means lift the misplaced bottom corner. REORIENT means use yellow-up insertion or a trigger. Preservation is required after a complete skill, not every internal turn.

criteria.align: Target is on top but not directly above its home bottom slot.
criteria.insert: Target is above its home bottom slot with yellow facing sideways.
criteria.reorient: Target is above its home with yellow pointing U.
criteria.extract: Target is in bottom but misplaced or twisted.
